_comment: Voice-over for the submission video, one entry per beat of tests/demo.spec.ts. scripts/make-video.mjs speaks each line with Piper, the demo waits for each line to finish before the next beat, and the same text is burned in as captions. The 'say' line is also played into the browser's microphone, so the real Amazon Transcribe hears it.
title: SpatialDesk Command Center
subtitle: A hands-first workspace for Meta Quest and Meta VR Glasses, with an AI agent you can talk to, that acts, explains, and can be undone.

beats.text: SpatialDesk is a workspace you wear. Before I put the headset on, I describe my day in my own words.
Inside, I sit at my desk at dusk. The board I am working on stands on it, within arm's reach, and everything else waits at the sides.
One tap on Plan my day. Amazon Nova answers with a single tool call, and the same Kotlin engine that runs in the headset checks every step.
Nothing changes until I say so. Each step says what it will do, and why.
One tap applies the plan: a Today board in front of me, and a focus timer.
By hand it's just as direct. Pick a card up, drop it in Doing. Every target is tested against hand-tracking jitter.
Put the dentist call at the top of my list.
Amazon Transcribe hears me, and the agent turns my words into a plan I can check. One tap, or a yes, applies it.
Timers run in seconds in this video. When the block ends, the plant on my desk grows a new leaf, and the agent notices on its own.
It knows the report isn't finished, because the app tells it how much of the estimate is used. So it suggests a break, not a false done.
The AI log shows everything the agent did: each step with its reason, and its own undo, even after later changes.
Hands-free: I look at a button and hold my gaze until the ring fills. Where the headset tracks my eyes, my eyes alone are enough.
The panel keeps score of my own work: focus blocks today, my streak, and the last seven days.
In the evening the agent offers to wrap up my day. It names what I finished, clears it away, and tomorrow's plan starts from its words.
On a Quest 3 it also lives in my real room. Fit room stands my board on my real desk, with the timer and my plant beside it, hangs the others on my walls, and remembers them for tomorrow.
And it is ready for Meta VR Glasses. The app reads the field of view the headset reports and fits the layout into it. I look at a card and pinch.
SpatialDesk: hands, eyes and voice, and an agent you can audit, in VR and in your own room. Every claim is checked automatically in Meta's emulator. Open the link: there is nothing to install.
